item.title: Version 0.1.174
item.description: • Tasks: Today, Tomorrow and Next Week keep a reminder's time and its alert (sticky notes, right-click menu and the date chips).

item.title: Version 0.1.173
item.description: • Folio layout: Tasks show as sticky notes (overdue pink, important blue, the rest yellow); click a note to edit it beside the note.

item.title: Version 0.1.172
item.description: • Shortcuts: Send (and other commands while writing) can take ⌘↩ in Settings → Shortcuts.

item.title: Version 0.1.171
item.description: • AI assistants: a recipient an assistant adds who isn't already in the conversation is flagged in Compose (Added by …), and Send stays off until you confirm each one. Flagged drafts aren't saved to Gmail until confirmed.

item.title: Version 0.1.170
item.description: • AI assistants: only Remedio's signed helper can connect, and each assistant is paired with the program that really launched it (shown as Started by …). Each assistant asks for your permission once more after this update.

item.title: Version 0.1.169
item.description: • Undo and Redo (⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z, and the toast) for Delete, Archive, Move, Move to Junk, Labels and Read/Unread, from the list and message windows. Flags and snoozes aren't undoable: use Unflag or Unsnooze.

item.title: Version 0.1.168
item.description: • AI assistants (MCP): mail HTML is handed over as a small safe subset (no scripts, styles, images or remote content); every result marks other people's text as untrusted; Activity logs every request, including refused ones.

item.title: Version 0.1.167
item.description: • Calendar: a dragged event stays under the pointer where you grabbed it, also across the squeezed off-hours.

item.title: Version 0.1.166
item.description:
• Calendar: working hours get the room and empty off-hours are compressed and shaded, so a normal day fits without scrolling (set your working hours in Settings → Calendar).
  • Zoom the calendar with ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⇧⌘0 or pinch, remembered per layout; it keeps the time you were looking at.

item.title: Version 0.1.165
item.description: • Desk mode (off by default; turn it on in Settings): one page with Triage, mail you owe and are owed, your next meeting, tasks and plugin sections. Make a task, Later and Done each with Undo.

item.title: Version 0.1.164
item.description: • Calendar: labels on short back-to-back events shrink to fit inside their block instead of spilling over.

item.title: Version 0.1.163
item.description: • The Four panels icon now fills the whole Dock tile.

item.title: Version 0.1.162
item.description: • Calendar: back-to-back short events (like two 15-minute meetings) stack full width with a visible gap between them, instead of side by side.

item.title: Version 0.1.161
item.description: • A new app icon: Four panels. An envelope whose folds split it into Mail, Calendar, Tasks and Contacts.

item.title: Version 0.1.160
item.description: • Calendar: back-to-back short events (like two 15-minute meetings) sit side by side instead of drawing one over the other.

item.title: Version 0.1.159
item.description: • Calendar: event text stays readable on any calendar colour, including white and yellow, in the Gmail layout.

item.title: Version 0.1.158
item.description: • Calendar: right-click a calendar to change its colour (Apple's 7 colours, a custom colour, or back to the original). Google calendars save the colour to Google; it shows at once in the sidebar, grid and My Day.

item.title: Version 0.1.157
item.description:
• Tasks: a + on each account in the sidebar (New List or New Task in that account).
  • Every layout edits a task right under it in the list; the Apple Mail layout now uses the Gmail look, and Outlook no longer opens details on the far side.
  • Fixes for offline copies, moved subtasks and deleting parent tasks.

item.title: Version 0.1.156
item.description: • With Esc set to close a new message, Send now waits until the Esc save finishes, so a message never goes out without your last edits.

item.title: Version 0.1.155
item.description:
• Change any menu shortcut in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts → Menu Shortcuts: record a new key, swap when it's taken, reset one or all. Tooltips show your keys.
  • New setting: Esc in a new message can close it (Windows style), keeping it in Drafts.
  • A new message with only a picture is no longer thrown away by ⌘W.

item.title: Version 0.1.154
item.description: • Link check: a link whose text is drawn by the email's styling now asks before opening an outside site, so a fake address split across styled text can't slip through.

item.title: Version 0.1.153
item.description:
• Tasks rebuilt: a layout for each window layout (Reminders-style in Apple Mail, To Do-style in Outlook, Google Tasks-style in Gmail, Things-style in Folio).
  • Edits are instant and reach Google in the background, even across a quit; no raw links in Google's notes.
  • New, rename and delete lists; subtasks; Completed view; search; Undo.
  • Star Google tasks (kept on this Mac, with a one-time note).

item.title: Version 0.1.152
item.description:
• Hover any link or button in a message to see where it really goes: the site in bold, then the full address, with a warning for look-alike sites.
  • Clicking a suspicious link asks first (“This opens examp1e.com. Open it?”) with the reason and full address.
  • javascript:, data: and file: links never open, and forms in mail never send.

item.title: Version 0.1.151
item.description: • Invites: the clash check only looks at a sensible window around the meeting, so a malformed invite can't make the app read years of your calendar.

item.title: Version 0.1.150
item.description:
• Answer meeting invites from the email: a card above the message shows the meeting, your answer and Yes / Maybe / No (with an optional note), clashes with your calendar and what changed. Opening an invite.ics shows the same card instead of the Mac's Calendar.
  • Cancellations show Cancelled with Remove from Calendar; new invites offer Add to Calendar.
  • Right-click an event: Open, Edit, Join, Going?, Email Guests, Copy Link or Details, Duplicate, Move to Calendar, Colour, Delete or Remove.

item.title: Version 0.1.149
item.description: • Reliability work behind the scenes: tests no longer fail at random under load.

item.title: Version 0.1.148
item.description:
• Search: “Load more from Gmail” stays available even when another account's search fails.
  • Highlighting matches in long messages is much faster.

item.title: Version 0.1.147
item.description:
• Search asks Gmail too, so it finds mail that isn't on this Mac yet, plus bcc:, list:, category: and more.
  • A results bar in every layout: scope (all mailboxes, this list, an account), your search as chips, Unread / Flagged / Attachments / Date / Spam & Trash filters, and a full search options form.
  • Suggestions for people, labels and recent searches; matched words are highlighted, Hebrew included.
  • ⌘F finds text in the open message; / or ⌥⌘F jumps to search; Esc clears it.
  • Saved searches ask Gmail too.

item.title: Version 0.1.146
item.description: • The AI assistants' activity log is saved while the Mac is locked; if it ever can't be saved, Settings → AI Assistants says so.

item.title: Version 0.1.145
item.description:
• Standard Mac shortcuts: ⌘W closes the window, ⌥⌘W closes all, ⌘0 brings the main window back, ⇧⌘J Junk, ⇧⌘D Send, ⇧⌘A Attach, ⌥⌘0 My Day, ⌥⌘1–3 reading pane.
  • Shortcuts in a message window act on that message, not on the list behind it.
  • Calendar's Day/Work Week/Week/Month (⌃⌘1–4) no longer clash with Layout.
  • Signature changes made while the Mac is locked are no longer lost.

item.title: Version 0.1.144
item.description: • Folio: unread mail stands out again: bold sender and subject with the dot; read mail is lighter and grey.

item.title: Version 0.1.143
item.description:
• Copy messages with ⌘C and paste them into a new mail with ⌘V: each one is attached as an email (.eml), like Forward as Attachment.
  • Drag a message onto a compose window to attach it; paste in Finder to save .eml files.

item.title: Version 0.1.142
item.description:
• Outlook layout: hovering a message no longer hides the date or moves anything; the quick buttons appear on the subject line.
  • No row shifts when mail is read (Outlook, Gmail, Folio).
  • Apple Mail: the toolbar stays the same whether or not a message is selected, and the My Day button no longer folds away.

item.title: Version 0.1.141
item.description:
• Search: from: and to: work with a space after the colon, a partial address, a name or a domain (from: mor, from: remedio.io). The list says Search Results while you search.
  • Folio: the search field is one flat shape, and no top bar control has a second outline.

item.title: Version 0.1.140
item.description:
• Tasks: a New Task button, New Task on right-click in a list, and Create Task on a message's right-click (it links back to the mail).
  • Pick a Date works, and the email and notes icons on a task open the email and the details.
  • Mark as important works for Reminders tasks; Google Tasks has no importance, so the star is hidden for Google tasks.
  • New tasks from My Day, All or Planned go to your Google list.

item.title: Version 0.1.139
item.description:
• Folio: searching from Calendar or Tasks always shows the mail results, even when Drafts, Outbox or Scheduled was open.
  • Delete animations stay smooth when rows have label chips.

item.title: Version 0.1.138
item.description:
• Folio layout: one top bar in every module (Search anything, no wordmark, the sidebar button stays put), and rows, sidebar and reader measured from the Folio design.
  • The External pill is red with black text in every theme (softer red in soft themes).
  • Flag in Folio's reader works with follow-ups and tasks; a quick second click no longer makes a duplicate task.
  • README lists the four layouts.

item.title: Version 0.1.137
item.description:
• New layout: Folio (View → Layout → Folio, ⌃⌘4). A folio top bar with search in the middle, your account and a Compose button in the sidebar, Spaces for labels, a large Inbox title, and a calm reader with its own actions.
  • Works with every theme; pair it with Folio or Folio Dark for the full look.

item.title: Version 0.1.136
item.description:
• Folio follows its design spec exactly: stone sidebar, paper list with hairlines, an olive bar on the selected row, a large reader title and soft notice banners.
  • Folio Dark gets the same.

item.title: Version 0.1.135
item.description:
• Folio: plain buttons (Snooze, Dismiss…) are quiet again instead of dark slabs, in every styled theme.
  • Folio: a softer message list with lighter unread senders, smaller dots and a softer selection.

item.title: Version 0.1.134
item.description: • New themes: Folio and Folio Dark (Settings → Appearance): warm paper or charcoal, olive accents, quiet editorial type.

item.title: Version 0.1.133
item.description: • Compose: the Add Online Meeting button is gone. Add Zoom to a meeting from the Calendar event editor instead.

item.title: Version 0.1.132
item.description: • Compose: the Add Online Meeting button (Zoom) shows again when Zoom is connected.

item.title: Version 0.1.131
item.description: • Compose: Paste and Match Style (⌥⇧⌘V) pastes without formatting, from the Edit menu, the body's right-click menu and every layout's toolbar.

item.title: Version 0.1.130
item.description: • People: a person's card no longer lists meetings or Join buttons.

item.title: Version 0.1.129
item.description:
• Calendar saves: a save that may have reached Google always comes back as 'may not have been saved' (never 'wasn't saved'), even across an account reconnect, so Save Again can't duplicate it.
  • Reconnecting an account keeps its unsaved changes as notices; a save from a removed account can't reach the reconnected one.
  • Open in Calendar shows a hidden calendar and goes to the event's real date.

item.title: Version 0.1.128
item.description: • People: a person's details no longer show after their account or the company directory is removed.

item.title: Version 0.1.127
item.description: • Settings → AI Assistants: Export… saves the Claude extension for your organization owner to upload; a hint explains that in an organization-managed Claude you install Remedio Mail from Claude's own extensions list.

item.title: Version 0.1.126
item.description: • Delete motion: after closing a full-size message, a later sync no longer plays the motion; departing rows stay put at the bottom of a long list.

item.title: Version 0.1.125
item.description:
• Calendar saves survive a crash or quit: every change is kept until it lands. After a crash, a change that never started comes back as 'wasn't saved' (Save Again, Edit…); one that was mid-way comes back as 'may not have been saved' (Open in Calendar, Save Again, Discard). Nothing is deleted on a guess.
  • Quitting never hangs: it waits at most 20 seconds for saves in progress.
  • Removing and re-adding an account mid-save can't send the old save to the new account.

item.title: Version 0.1.124
item.description: • After snoozing or moving many messages at once, a later sync no longer plays the delete motion or holds your click.

item.title: Version 0.1.123
item.description: • Delete motions polished: rows glide correctly at the bottom of a long list, mail removed by a sync no longer plays the motion or holds your click, Slide out leaves an unrelated selection alone, and Lift's spring settles fully.

item.title: Version 0.1.122
item.description: • My Day's Flagged Emails and Tasks leave out flagged mail in Trash and Junk, like the sidebar count, and a just-unflagged message can't come back.

item.title: Version 0.1.121
item.description:
• Flagged (Starred in the Gmail layout) shows how many flagged messages you have, in the sidebar and in the Flagged search folder.
  • Flagged mail in Trash or Junk is no longer listed or counted.

item.title: Version 0.1.120
item.description:
• Settings → Reading → When you delete a message: Fold and glide (default), Lift and settle, Slide out, or Simple. Reduce Motion makes every style instant.
  • Works for delete, archive, move, junk and snooze, one or several messages, in every layout; Drafts follow the style's timing.

item.title: Version 0.1.119
item.description: • Removing an account removes its contacts for good, and the company directory goes away when the account that reads it is removed; People, address suggestions and sender warnings refresh on their own.

item.title: Version 0.1.118
item.description: • Draft preview shows the current Gmail version (with Bcc), and pasted images show in local drafts.

item.title: Version 0.1.117
item.description:
• Saving events is hardened: quitting, a crash, a delete or an account removal in the middle of a save can't lose the event, duplicate it or leave a dead Zoom link.
  • Removing an account or turning a plugin off removes its tasks for good, also after a relaunch.

item.title: Version 0.1.116
item.description:
• Drafts: delete a draft from the toolbar, menu, Delete key, # or swipe, one or several at once; the Gmail copy goes too.
  • Selecting a draft previews it (recipients, subject, body, attachments) with an Edit button; Return or double-click keeps writing it.

item.title: Version 0.1.115
item.description:
• Removing an account is final for its meetings, reminders and banners: nothing running in the background can bring them back, also after a relaunch or re-adding the account.
  • Meeting banners keep their right times even after a long permission prompt.

item.title: Version 0.1.114
item.description:
• Settings → AI Assistants: Install in Claude (one click, Claude Desktop shows its own prompt) and Copy Command for Claude Code. Both ship inside the app; no more copying JSON.
  • Other assistants keep the JSON under 'Other assistants', pointing at the installed app.

item.title: Version 0.1.113
item.description:
• A removed account's meeting banners can't come back, even if a reminder refresh was running.
  • My Day keeps your saved Google meetings when both Google and your Mac calendar are offline.

item.title: Version 0.1.112
item.description:
• A just-saved event stays visible while the calendar refreshes.
  • Quitting during the tidy-up after a save never offers a Retry that would duplicate the event.

item.title: Version 0.1.111
item.description:
• Removing an account cancels its pending meeting banners at once.
  • My Day no longer shows a stale Google meeting when Google is down and your Mac calendar has the account.

item.title: Version 0.1.110
item.description:
• Saving an event is instant: the editor closes at once and the event shows (dimmed) while Google and Zoom finish in the background.
  • If a save fails, a banner per event offers Retry or Edit… with what you typed; if only Zoom fails, the event is saved without the link and the banner says so.
  • Quitting waits for events still saving; anything that couldn't finish comes back as a notice at the next launch.

item.title: Version 0.1.109
item.description:
• My Day: the red now-line runs through the meeting that's on now, at the right point, and moves with time.
  • My Day shows a new, changed or deleted event at once, without switching days.
  • Meeting reminders: a moved or cancelled meeting's reminder doesn't come back, no doubles when Google is down but your Mac calendar has the meeting, and a removed account's reminders go away.

item.title: Version 0.1.108
item.description:
• Meeting reminders stay put when a calendar can't be reached (also after reopening the app offline).
  • Changing Keep on screen or reminder sound applies right away, also to reminders already showing or scheduled.

item.title: Version 0.1.107
item.description:
• Meeting reminders stay on screen until you dismiss them: a Remedio Mail reminders panel with Join, Snooze and Dismiss (it never takes over your typing).
  • Settings → General: notifications for new mail and meetings (Off, Banner or Persistent), how long reminders stay, sound, and how early meetings remind you.
  • HubSpot is back in Settings → Plugins, with Remedio's new HubSpot app.

item.title: Version 0.1.106
item.description: • AI assistants see each contact's id, so they can report an instruction hidden in a contact.

item.title: Version 0.1.105
item.description: • AI assistants can report instructions hidden in events, contacts, drafts and tasks too, not only in mail.

item.title: Version 0.1.104
item.description:
• AI assistants (MCP): mail is treated as data, never instructions. Text in a message that tries to instruct an AI is refused and shows as flagged in Settings → AI Assistants → Activity.
  • A remedio-mail plugin for Claude Code ships in the repo.

item.title: Version 0.1.103
item.description:
• The My Day button stays at the toolbar's right end (above My Day when it's open) and follows the window as you stretch it.
  • Outlook layout: search sits in the middle of the title bar, and the My Day button is back above My Day, so you can close it where you expect.

item.title: Version 0.1.102
item.description: • A message you move, delete or snooze shows in its new folder (Trash, Snoozed, the destination) right away, without waiting for Gmail.

item.title: Version 0.1.101
item.description:
• Deleting, archiving or moving a message is smooth now: the row folds away, the list glides up and the selection stays where it is (no more jump).
  • The list no longer redraws when the background check finds nothing new.

item.title: Version 0.1.100
item.description:
• Calendar: add guests and rooms right from the Scheduling tab; remove someone from the grid with ×.
  • Deleting an event now asks first (Delete and Notify for your meetings with guests; this event or all future ones for repeating events).
  • Zoom meetings get the event's guest list, and it's kept up to date when guests change.

item.title: Version 0.1.99
item.description: • A malformed answer from IT.remedio.io can no longer empty the Mac's copy of the company directory.

item.title: Version 0.1.98
item.description: • A malformed answer from IT.remedio.io can no longer empty the Mac's copy of the company directory.

item.title: Version 0.1.97
item.description:
• The company directory from IT.remedio.io loads again (it failed with “sent an unexpected response”).
  • Clearer messages when IT.remedio.io refuses: not in the directory yet (ask IT), switched off, busy.
  • Company templates switched off at IT is no longer shown as an error.

item.title: Version 0.1.96
item.description:
• The company directory from IT.remedio.io loads again (it failed with “sent an unexpected response”).
  • Clearer messages when IT.remedio.io refuses: not in the directory yet (ask IT), switched off, busy.
  • Company templates switched off at IT is no longer shown as an error.

item.title: Version 0.1.95
item.description: • Settings → Accounts no longer goes blank with a Gmail account selected.

item.title: Version 0.1.94
item.description: • Sender warnings: company alias domains count as internal when the directory shows them, so colleagues on them aren't marked External.

item.title: Version 0.1.93
item.description: • Labels: a newly created label is ticked only on messages it really went on.

item.title: Version 0.1.92
item.description: • Sender warnings: disguised links through Google or Outlook redirects are checked against their real destination, and mail you send from a send-as alias counts as yours.

item.title: Version 0.1.91
item.description:
• Labels: Gmail's own names (Trash, Spam, Inbox…) can't be created as labels, and ticks made while a new label is being created stay put.
  • Scheduling: all-day events count in your calendar's time zone, not the Mac's.

item.title: Version 0.1.90
item.description: • Sender warnings: a stranger who mails you often no longer silences look-alike warnings (only people you've written to count), and disguised links can't hide behind the shown domain in their path.

item.title: Version 0.1.89
item.description:
• Labels: add or remove several Gmail labels at once (Label As, or L), create labels, colour them; coloured label chips in the list and reader. In the Outlook layout this is Categorize.
  • Scheduling: editing a meeting no longer hides other meetings that overlap it, and working hours stay right on daylight-saving days.

item.title: Version 0.1.88
item.description:
• Sender warnings: mail from outside Remedio is marked, and look-alike or failed-authentication senders get a clear warning.
  • Keyboard: Gmail-style single-key shortcuts (j/k, e, #, r, g i…), customizable in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts; press ? for the list.
  • New mail: labels created or renamed in Gmail show up within 5 minutes, and back-off is respected.
  • Apple Mail layout: list widths save on first drag and in right-to-left too.

item.title: Version 0.1.87
item.description:
• Calendar: a Scheduling view in the event editor shows when attendees and rooms are free, with suggested times.
  • Admin: IT can set and lock settings, plugins, AI assistant access and allowed account domains through an MDM profile (docs/admin).

item.title: Version 0.1.86
item.description: • New mail arrives within about 20 seconds, and right away when the Mac wakes, the network comes back or you switch to the app. Each check is one small request; the app backs off if Gmail asks it to slow down.

item.title: Version 0.1.85
item.description: • Apple Mail layout: the sidebar and message list keep the widths you set, across relaunches and updates.

item.title: Version 0.1.84
item.description: • Mark as read: the delay starts over when you come back to a message, nothing is marked read while Mail is hidden, and separate message windows follow the setting too.

item.title: Version 0.1.83
item.description:
• Settings: a new searchable sidebar window with panes grouped under Mail, This Mac and Integrations.
  • New settings: mark as read, what to show after delete or archive, ask before deleting, send-from account, Reply or Reply All for ⌘R, reply above or below the quote, new-mail banner, sound and Dock count, open at login, update checks.
  • Rules: a Gmail filter using options Remedio Mail doesn't support is read-only, so saving can't drop them.

item.title: Version 0.1.82
item.description: • Rules: Gmail filters load even when Gmail's answer has fields the app doesn't know; a missing permission offers Reconnect right there.

item.title: Version 0.1.81
item.description: • HubSpot plugin prepared for per-user access (still hidden until its sign-in is set up).

item.title: Version 0.1.80
item.description: • HubSpot: connect it in Settings → Plugins → HubSpot to see a sender's contact, company and deals.

item.title: Version 0.1.79
item.description:
• People and Compose use Remedio's company directory from IT.remedio.io.
  • Snooze: a message wakes once, and snoozing it again while it wakes keeps the new time.
  • Templates: names with quote marks can't break a template's HTML.

item.title: Version 0.1.78
item.description: • Templates: the company's templates refresh each time you open the Templates menu.

item.title: Version 0.1.77
item.description: • Gmail filter editor: after a failed apply, edits you make are saved instead of silently ignored.

item.title: Version 0.1.76
item.description:
• Snooze: hide a message until later; it comes back to the top of the Inbox, unread, with a notification. Snoozed mailbox in the sidebar.
  • Templates: insert, save and manage your own templates with {FirstName} and other placeholders (Settings → Templates).
  • Fixes: Print stops instead of making an incomplete PDF; Gmail filter sizes stay exact and a failed apply no longer saves twice; several rules on one message all apply; a saved search matches exactly what the search showed.

item.title: Version 0.1.75
item.description:
• Snooze: hide a message until later (Later Today, Tomorrow, This Weekend, Next Week or a date); it comes back to the top of the Inbox, unread, with a notification. Snoozed mailbox in the sidebar.
  • Templates: insert, save and manage your own templates, with {FirstName} and other placeholders (Settings → Templates).

item.title: Version 0.1.74
item.description:
• Search Folders: Unread Mail, Flagged and your own saved searches in the sidebar, with live counts.
  • Search operators: from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, is:unread, in:, label:, dates, sizes, quotes, -, OR, with suggestions as you type.
  • Rules: edit your Gmail filters in Settings → Rules, local rules for alerts, and Create Rule from Message….
  • Undo Send on by default (Settings → Composing), and Send Later with a Scheduled mailbox.
  • Print and Save as PDF (⌘P) for messages, threads and calendar views.
  • @mentions in Compose add the person or group to Cc.

item.title: Version 0.1.73
item.description:
• AI assistants: a Gmail copy of a sent draft is always removed, even when you were offline at send time.
  • Queued actions on a message that no longer exists no longer block the rest.

item.title: Version 0.1.72
item.description:
• Fixes a rare stall when a setting changed in the background.
  • AI assistants: cleanup after a successful send can no longer clash with an assistant editing the same draft.

item.title: Version 0.1.71
item.description:
• AI assistants (MCP): Settings → AI Assistants lets Claude (and ChatGPT via OpenAI's tunnel) read mail, calendar, tasks and contacts and write drafts. It never sends or deletes. Off by default.
  • No divider line crosses the toolbar any more.
  • From, Signature, Online meeting, Font and the remote-images menu open as floating menus; suggestions stay on screen and replace the whole half-typed address. The font box shows System Font.
  • Compose: type any font size in the size box.
  • Company directory from Remedio IT, with groups (switched off until its server is live). HubSpot plugin (hidden until its sign-in is set up).

item.title: Version 0.1.70
item.description:
• AI assistants (MCP): Settings → AI Assistants lets Claude (and ChatGPT via OpenAI's tunnel) read mail, calendar, tasks and contacts and write drafts. It never sends or deletes. Off by default.
  • From, Signature, Online meeting, Font and the remote-images menu open as floating menus in your theme; suggestions stay on screen and replace the whole half-typed address.
  • Compose: type any font size in the size box.
  • Company directory from Remedio IT, including groups (switched off until its server is live).
  • HubSpot plugin (hidden until its sign-in is set up).

item.title: Version 0.1.69
item.description:
• From, Signature, Online meeting, Font and the remote-images menu open as floating menus in your theme; suggestions stay on screen and replace the whole half-typed address.
  • Compose: type any font size in the size box.
  • Company directory groups from Remedio IT (still switched off until its server is live).
  • HubSpot plugin (hidden until its sign-in is set up).

item.title: Version 0.1.68
item.description:
• Suggestions, event popovers, date and time pickers, the invitee list and the Undo Send toast now float in your theme's style.
  • A new message or Forward opens with the cursor in To; a Reply opens in the body above the quote.

item.title: Version 0.1.67
item.description: • My Day's mini calendar header matches Outlook: ‹ › on the left, then the month with ⌄ to expand.

item.title: Version 0.1.66
item.description: • My Day's mini calendar: ‹ on the left, › on the right, and the expand arrow under the weeks.

item.title: Version 0.1.65
item.description: • Signatures: a pasted picture that comes back (Redo, or pasted again) keeps its downloaded image.

item.title: Version 0.1.64
item.description: • Signatures: a paste goes in at once where you pasted it; its pictures fill in when they finish downloading, even if you've moved on or closed the pane.

item.title: Version 0.1.63
item.description: • Signatures: pasted or dropped pictures are embedded the moment they arrive, and leaving the editor saves exactly what you typed, so nothing finishes in the background afterwards.

item.title: Version 0.1.62
item.description: • Signatures: pasted pictures are kept even if you reopen a signature quickly, and an unsaved Gmail edit keeps its pictures' links when Gmail removes the signature.

item.title: Version 0.1.61
item.description: • Signatures: unsaved edits survive Gmail clearing a signature, a save finishing while you type, reopening a signature while pictures embed, and a sync racing a save.

item.title: Version 0.1.60
item.description:
• Compose: Replace All never crosses a line break or removes a picture, and works with any letters when ignoring case.
  • Signatures: leaving the editor keeps your edits; an unsaved Gmail edit is kept (marked with a dot) until you Save to Gmail or Revert.
  • Zoom: a meeting that couldn't be deleted after a failed save is retried on the next sync.

item.title: Version 0.1.59
item.description:
• Calendar: every meeting is its own colored chip, with a gentle hover.
  • Message windows keep their message, show Try Again instead of spinning, and marking read never undoes other changes. With the Reading Pane off, selecting no longer marks read; archiving an opened message returns to the list.
  • Zoom: editing all future events from the first occurrence keeps the one meeting.
  • Compose: table deletions undo, Format Painter keeps links, pictures and lists, Replace All finds text across formatting, Grow Font on mixed sizes grows.
  • My Day reads a calendar again after a failed read.

item.title: Version 0.1.58
item.description:
• Message windows keep their message when the main list changes, show an error with Try Again instead of spinning, and the Reading Pane off no longer marks messages read.
  • My Day reads a calendar again after a failed read.
  • Compose: Grow Font on mixed sizes grows from the largest.

item.title: Version 0.1.57
item.description:
• Zoom meetings follow their event: one per event, renamed or moved with it, deleted with it (only meetings Remedio Mail created). One 'Online meeting' row (None, Zoom, Google Meet or Teams). New setting: Settings → Plugins → Zoom → Add a Zoom meeting to new events. Reconnect Zoom once after this update.
  • My Day's mini calendar marks only the day you picked.
  • The signature editor recovers the latest version if its page crashes.

item.title: Version 0.1.56
item.description: • Zoom meetings follow their event: one per event, renamed or moved with it, deleted with it. One 'Online meeting' row (None, Zoom, Google Meet or Teams). New setting: Settings → Plugins → Zoom → Add a Zoom meeting to new events. Reconnect Zoom once after this update.

item.title: Version 0.1.55
item.description:
• Calendar loads at launch, so opening it is instant.
  • My Day: stepping days and paging the mini calendar show stored events at once; the mini calendar's dots follow the periodic refresh, and its header names the month most shown days fall in.

item.title: Version 0.1.54
item.description:
• Gmail signatures: no false 'changed in Gmail' warning after your own save, and no stray Save button when the editor reloads.
  • Collapsed folder pane (Outlook, Gmail): errors show as a warning button, and folder tooltips name their account when you have several.

item.title: Version 0.1.53
item.description: • Zoom is available: Settings → Plugins → Zoom → Connect, then add a Zoom meeting to an invitation.

item.title: Version 0.1.52
item.description: • Gmail signatures: a Gmail update that arrives while Settings → Signatures is still loading now shows up.

item.title: Version 0.1.51
item.description: • Gmail signatures: a Gmail update never replaces a signature you're editing, even mid-keystroke.

item.title: Version 0.1.50
item.description: • Gmail signatures: a Gmail update arriving while you type in Settings → Signatures no longer replaces what you just typed.

item.title: Version 0.1.49
item.description: • Gmail signatures: Save to Gmail never overwrites a newer Gmail version or drops pictures that didn't download; you get a warning instead.

item.title: Version 0.1.48
item.description:
• Gmail signatures can be edited in Settings → Signatures and saved back to Gmail (reconnect your Google account once first).
  • More tests for drafts saved in Gmail.

item.title: Version 0.1.47
item.description: • My Day no longer jumps in one window when you resize it in another

item.title: Version 0.1.46
item.description: • Each window keeps its own My Day width and folder-pane collapse; ⌃⌘S acts on the window in front

item.title: Version 0.1.45
item.description:
• My Day is now its own column: dragging its divider never changes the window size, and it stops where the message reaches its minimum
  • Your My Day width carries over; message actions stay above the message and the My Day button above My Day

item.title: Version 0.1.44
item.description: • My Day's divider widens My Day only into room the window has; it no longer jumps to its maximum or makes the window much wider

item.title: Version 0.1.43
item.description: • Apple Mail layout: the sidebar divider can be dragged again (it stopped responding in 0.1.38); the list divider and My Day stay put and the window keeps its size

item.title: Version 0.1.42
item.description:
• Gmail drafts only open when they can be fully downloaded; otherwise you see an error with Try Again, and the draft on the server is never touched
  • Bcc recipients are kept when opening a Gmail draft
  • The Drafts list updates after each sync

item.title: Version 0.1.41
item.description:
• One Drafts mailbox: drafts saved in the app and in Gmail together, newest first, no duplicates
  • Gmail drafts open in Compose, editable with their attachments; sending or deleting moves the server copy to Trash

item.title: Version 0.1.40
item.description:
• Compose: the font size box shows the actual size at the cursor
  • Outlook ribbon: group contents centred

item.title: Version 0.1.39
item.description:
• Message rows show From, Subject and Preview stacked in every layout
  • Message List setting: Subject only, or Subject + 1–3 preview lines (Settings → Appearance, View → Message List)
  • Outlook and Gmail: the folder pane folds to an icon column (sidebar button, ⌃⌘S, double-click or drag the divider)

item.title: Version 0.1.38
item.description:
• Compose toolbars polished: Outlook ribbon groups line up, consistent icons, format bars aligned with the address fields
  • Right-to-left layouts: each divider still moves only its own edge

item.title: Version 0.1.37
item.description:
• One set of mailboxes with a single account in every layout (Inbox, not All Inboxes)
  • Gmail layout: Gmail's own order, a folding More (Drafts on Server, Junk, Trash, Archive), a Labels heading, and the unread count in the empty reader
  • Gmail layout: toolbar row, search field and Compose button match Gmail

item.title: Version 0.1.36
item.description: • Drafts and Outbox titles show their own counts (N drafts, N waiting to send)

item.title: Version 0.1.35
item.description:
• Reading Pane: Right, Bottom or Off (View → Reading Pane, ⌥⌘1–3), saved per layout; double-click opens a message in its own window
  • Signatures sync from Gmail automatically
  • Remote images: tighter privacy (allow-lists apply exactly, plus-addresses stay separate, older messages are re-checked)

item.title: Version 0.1.34
item.description:
• HTML signatures: several per account, imported from Gmail, defaults for new mail and replies, switch them from Compose (Settings → Signatures)
  • Outlook-level formatting: fonts and sizes, colors and highlight, lists, indent, alignment, line spacing, headings, links, pictures, tables, emoji, Format Painter, Find and Replace, Paste as Plain Text
  • Importance High/Low and read receipts

item.title: Version 0.1.33
item.description:
• My Day: Outlook-style mini calendar with week rows, a full-month view and event dots (Settings → Calendar → My Day)
  • Display density Compact / Cozy / Roomy for messages and folders (Settings → Appearance, View → Density ⌃⌥⌘1/2/3)

item.title: Version 0.1.32
item.description:
• Remote images: Always Load from this sender or domain, right from the banner
  • New Settings → Privacy: load remote images Ask/Always/Never, an allowed-senders list, optionally your organization, and auto-download of small attachments
  • Junk and mail that fails sender checks never load images automatically

item.title: Version 0.1.31
item.description:
• My Day: one continuous toolbar band in every layout, and only one button to open it
  • Apple Mail layout: the list/reader line stops at the toolbar; the mailbox title has proper spacing
  • Gmail layout: one set of mailboxes with a single account; No Message Selected in the empty reader

item.title: Version 0.1.30
item.description: • Apple Mail layout: each divider moves only its own edge; dragging the message list's divider stops at the list's limit and never moves the sidebar (and the other way round)

item.title: Version 0.1.29
item.description: • My Day can be made 50% wider (up to 630 pt)

item.title: Version 0.1.28
item.description:
• Zoom shows 'Not available yet' until it's set up for Remedio, instead of asking you to create files; its Zoom options are hidden until then
  • Zoom sign-in uses PKCE with no secret

item.title: Version 0.1.27
item.description:
• Microsoft 365: replies on a colleague's shared calendar are refused; editing and deleting events on shared calendars now works
  • Remove from Calendar for cancelled meetings and unwanted invitations (on Google it tells the organizer you declined, as Google does)
  • Google working-location events no longer ring like meetings; read-only events never open the editor
  • Delegated Mac calendars count as shared: no reply buttons or reminders

item.title: Version 0.1.26
item.description:
• Apple Mail layout: dragging the message list no longer grows the mailbox sidebar; the sidebar stays 180–360 pt and an oversized saved width is corrected
  • The message list can be up to 900 pt wide; the reader always keeps room

item.title: Version 0.1.25
item.description:
• Clear empty states: No Messages (with Get New Mail), no search results, empty task lists with Add a Task, Nothing for Today
  • No more flashes before data loads; spinners only show after a short wait

item.title: Version 0.1.24
item.description: • Outlook and Gmail layouts: pane dividers can be dragged along their full height (also beside the message), show the resize cursor, and keep their width after relaunch

item.title: Version 0.1.23
item.description:
• VoiceOver: pane dividers can be resized with VoiceOver or the arrow keys; task rows, My Day items and invitee suggestions can be opened
  • Outbox: a sent message's draft is removed before the Outbox entry, so it never lingers in Drafts

item.title: Version 0.1.22
item.description:
• ⌘N follows the module: New Event in Calendar, New Task in To Do, New Message in Mail (⌥⌘N is always New Message)
  • Find… (⌥⌘F), Show/Hide My Day (⌥⌘0), Move to Trash (⌘⌫); in Calendar: Today (⌘T), Previous (⌘←), Next (⌘→)
  • Animations follow Reduce Motion; shortcuts toggle without animation

item.title: Version 0.1.21
item.description:
• Reopens where you left off: the last module, mailbox and message, the sidebar and My Day
  • More reliable local database when a send is still finishing

item.title: Version 0.1.20
item.description: • To Do list stops at a readable width on wide screens

item.title: Version 0.1.19
item.description: • Scroll positions stay put: the message list per mailbox, the Calendar's hour, and the Tasks and People lists, across module switches and relaunch

item.title: Version 0.1.18
item.description:
• Event editor: invitees as name chips with suggestions from your contacts and the directory
  • New date and time pickers: a month calendar for the date and a time list that shows the meeting length
  • Online meeting and rooms as pills; booked rooms as chips
  • Tasks: due date and reminder use the same date and time pickers

item.title: Version 0.1.17
item.description:
• Pane dividers keep their position after you quit, per layout and module; the window remembers its size and place
  • Each divider moves only its own edge (the Outlook reading pane no longer moves the folders)
  • Gmail layout: sidebar and message list can be resized

item.title: Version 0.1.16
item.description:
• Outlook layout: one toolbar band, and the module rail runs full height in one color, like new Outlook for Mac
  • Gmail layout: toolbar matches the window color
  • People's panes no longer draw over the title bar

item.title: Version 0.1.15
item.description:
• Groundwork for the company directory from IT.remedio.io (Settings → Accounts → Company directory; switched on once IT.remedio.io is ready)
  • Storage → Clear Directory also refreshes the company directory

item.title: Version 0.1.14
item.description:
• New Settings → Storage: how far back and ahead Calendar stays offline, how often data refreshes, how much mail downloads per mailbox
  • See how much space Mail, Attachments, Calendar, Tasks and Directory use, and clear each one
  • Old calendar events outside the window are trimmed automatically

item.title: Version 0.1.13
item.description:
• Send closes the message at once; it goes to the Outbox and sends in the background
  • Retries when offline or when Google is busy, and resumes after relaunch
  • If Google refuses a message, you're notified and it reopens for editing

item.title: Version 0.1.12
item.description:
• Calendar: new events default to your Google calendar; colleagues' calendars under Shared Calendars
  • Calendar: create events with right-click, double-click or drag (a click only selects); short events are readable
  • Room picker names the real reason when Google withholds the room list
  • Outlook and Gmail layouts: toolbar matches the window color; quieter My Day
  • One clear notice bar for blocked images and connection errors; clearer Add Account

item.title: Version 0.1.11
item.description:
• Switching between Mail, Calendar, Tasks and People is instant: each keeps its data and selection
  • Calendar, Tasks and My Day open from a local cache, then refresh in the background (and work offline)
  • Deleting, moving, replying to events and completing tasks show at once

item.title: Version 0.1.10
item.description:
• New Message looks like each layout's own app: Apple Mail, Outlook or Gmail
  • Recipients read as plain names; clearer placeholders and attachment chips
  • Settings → Accounts: Apple Mail's + / − bar, readable selection, no stripes
  • Readable selected rows and accent text in every theme

item.title: Version 0.1.9
item.description:
• Meeting reminders only for your own calendars, not colleagues' shared calendars, rooms or holidays
  • Shared and read-only calendars: no reply buttons, and invitations can't be edited or dragged unless you organize them
  • Cancelled meetings are dimmed, with no Join or reminder
  • Join only for real meeting links (not Gong or Zoom recordings)
  • Group invitations get reply buttons; private events show Busy
  • My Day's next meeting skips declined and cancelled ones

item.title: Version 0.1.8
item.description: • Accept / Tentative / Decline only show for invitations on your own calendar, never on colleagues' shared calendars

item.title: Version 0.1.7
item.description:
• Choose how many days My Day's agenda shows: 1, 3 or 7 (Settings → Calendar → My Day)
  • The agenda arrows step by that many days

item.title: Version 0.1.6
item.description:
• Google Tasks in Tasks and My Day; flagging a Gmail message creates a Google task (reconnect your Google account once in Settings → Accounts)
  • My Day's agenda shows only your own calendar, not shared or subscribed ones
  • Selected rows show white text again in themes without their own colors

item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
• My Day shows your Google Calendar meetings and tasks; emails dropped on the agenda become events in your Google calendar
  • New events default to your Google calendar
  • Coworkers show only their primary address in People and Compose
  • Settings stays on Appearance when you pick a theme
  • If macOS has notifications off, the app offers to open Notification Settings (needed for the Dock badge)
  • Developer builds run as a separate app

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
• Google sign-in built in
  • Company directory, your Google contacts and groups in People and Compose
  • Book meeting rooms from the event editor
  • Dock unread badge and new-mail banners: mail is checked every minute
  • Google Calendar events load again; the first sync waits out Gmail's per-minute limits
  • The module picker stays put when switching modules
  • Signed with Developer ID and notarized

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
• Updates itself: Remedio Mail now checks for new versions daily and installs them when you quit (or Remedio Mail → Check for Updates…).
  • Google Calendar inside the app: edit, create and delete events, Accept / Tentative / Decline invitations, Google Meet links.
  • Meeting reminders with a Join button (Settings → Calendar).
  • Work account offered automatically on Macs with Microsoft Entra Platform SSO.
